dispute.StageArbitration and dispute.ArbitrationSeat model arbitration as one stage plus a seat field within the dispute-resolution lifecycle; there is no dedicated arbitration rules/award-computation engine.
domains.gap_note: This is likely correct BY DESIGN rather than a true gap: the work order's own §XV (Contract-First Insurance) requires VERIQO never to decide who wins a dispute -- only a human/legal decision-maker may. A full automated 'arbitration engine' that produced an award would violate that principle. Flagged here as a completeness-audit row per the requested format, not as a recommended build item.
